footer.disclaimer: The platform is not a party to any payment. Users pay each other directly; the platform only records the confirmations they provide.

landing.heroTitle: 3D game assets — with nobody standing between you
landing.heroSubtitle: An AI brief builder, milestone-based deals, and reputation you can actually trust. No commission: you pay each other directly.
landing.forDesignersText: Real briefs instead of “make it look cool”, milestone payments, portfolio pieces verified by the platform, and levels clients can see.
landing.forCustomersText: AI turns your idea into a brief in minutes, milestones protect the budget, and ratings and disputes protect you from people who vanish.
landing.step1Text: Describe the task in plain words — AI turns it into a structured brief and points out what is missing.
landing.step2Text: Publish an order or invite an artist from the gallery. Proposals come with price, timeline and portfolio pieces.
landing.step3Text: Each milestone: delivery → review → direct payment → receipt confirmation. Source files unlock once the final payment is confirmed.
landing.noFeeText: The platform never touches the money. You settle up directly however you like, and the platform records the payment confirmations and the deal history.
landing.waitlistTitle: Leave your email — we'll send an invite
